description:
Research three specific AI-related bills from the 118th Congress (2023-2024) using Congress.gov: H.R. 926, S. 2293, and H.R. 5077. 

1. Navigate to Congress.gov and locate the official page for each bill (ensure you select the 118th Congress versions).
2. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'AI Legislation 118th' and bookmark the main overview page for each of the three bills.
3. Download the PDF full text of H.R. 5077 (CREATE AI Act) to '~/Documents/Bills/hr5077_text.pdf' (you may need to create the directory).
4. Create a status report at '~/Documents/legislative_report.json' containing the session, topic, and a list of bills with their number, short title, primary sponsor (Name only is fine), introduced date (YYYY-MM-DD), and latest action date (YYYY-MM-DD).
